heading.title: Central and State Advisory Boards on Disability and District Level Committee

article.title: District-level Committee on disability.
article.content:
72District-level Committee on disability.

Section 72  ·  Chapter XI  ·  page 26 of the Act
The State Government shall constitute District-level Committee on disability to perform such functions as may be prescribed by it.
